intent_en: Compare the nominal GDP of the United States, the European Union as a 28-country aggregate, China, and Japan.
narration_support: Don't forget to subscribe and click the bell button so that you can be part of our notification squad. The USA has the world's highest GDP of around $18 .5 trillion.
